title: [inductor] as_strided lowering throws away .view(dtype)
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Marking as high pri because this affects numerics.

Please see the original issue for full context: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/issues/1713#issuecomment-3299862886

## Repro instructions:

In torchtitan, check out https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/1701

In torchao, checkout https://github.com/pytorch/ao/pull/3004, and run USE_CPP=1 pip install -e ~/ao

On b200, from torchtitan root, run: `NGPU=4 CONFIG_FILE="./torchtitan/experiments/llama4/train_configs/debug_model.toml" ./run_train.sh --parallelism.data_parallel_shard_degree=4 --parallelism.tensor_parallel_degree=1 --model.converters="mx" --mx.recipe_name="mxfp8_cublas" --mx.moe_fqns_prototype="experts" --model.print-after-conversion --metrics.log_freq=10 --training.steps=30 --compile.enable`

Even though we output_scales_ptr is view'd as a uint8: https://github.com/pytorch/ao/blob/18dbe875a0ce279739dda06fda656e76845acaac/torchao/prototype/moe_training/kernels/mxfp8_blocked_scales.py#L278, we still see float8.e8m0fnu (not yet supported in triton).

* `--quantize.dense.float8.enable_fsdp_float8_all_gather`: cast `Float8Linear.weight` from high precision to float8 before FSDP all-gather so we can communicate in float8 to save bandwidth.

* `--quantize.dense.float8.filter_fqns="..."` (optional): a comma separated list of fully qualified names of modules not to convert to float8 training. Example: `--quantize.dense.float8.filter_fqns="attention.wk,attention.wv"`.
